# Hypeable

> Worth the hype. Free, open-source AI app builder. You bring your own model key. Hypeable hosts nothing.

Hypeable is a fork of bolt.diy (MIT). Describe an app, watch it get built in a WebContainer, publish it to your own Vercel or GitHub.

## How it differs

- Live cost meter: tokens × list price, session and daily caps, hard stop. Estimates, not invoices.
- Loop breaker: stop after 3 repeated identical errors, then replan / revert / switch model.
- Plan-first mode: show a plan, the user approves, then build.
- Pre-deploy security check: exposed keys, missing DB access rules, open CORS, debug flags — scanned in the browser before publish.
- Spend page (`/spend`): today, session, month-to-date, and recent builds from this browser only.

## Honest limits

- Hosted at hypeable.dev cannot reach local models (Ollama, LM Studio, custom OpenAI-compatible URLs). Run locally with `pnpm dev` for those.
- StackBlitz WebContainers is free for personal and open-source use. Commercial hosted use needs a StackBlitz license.
- Prices marked ≈ in the UI are unverified list prices from `app/lib/cost/prices.json`.
- Cost figures are estimates, not invoices. Accuracy against provider billing is not yet independently verified (docs/COST-ACCURACY.md). Set a limit on your provider too.
- Publish connectors (GitHub, GitLab, Vercel, Netlify, Supabase) are experimental.
- Some upstream tests are still being fixed; see docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md.
- Model keys take a server hop to the provider you chose. Hypeable does not store them. Direct browser-to-provider is not shipped yet.
